context: The system will digitize voice-based trading processes for trades valued under $1 million, replacing manual phone-based workflows with an automated electronic platform. This addresses compliance requirements for Singapore and Indonesia markets while ensuring auditability, transparency, and reduced operational risk in low-value trade execution.

userStories.title: Voice Trade Data Capture
userStories.iWantTo: capture voice trade details electronically in real-time
userStories.soThat: I can reduce manual errors and ensure all trade data is accurately recorded

acceptanceCriteria.given: A voice trade call is initiated
acceptanceCriteria.when: Trade details are spoken by the trader
acceptanceCriteria.then: System captures and converts voice to structured trade data

acceptanceCriteria.given: Trade data is captured from voice
acceptanceCriteria.then: Data is displayed for verification within 2 seconds

acceptanceCriteria.when: Data contains ambiguous or unclear information
acceptanceCriteria.then: System highlights fields requiring manual review

userStories.title: Trade Validation and Compliance
userStories.iWantTo: automatically validate trades against Singapore and Indonesia regulations
userStories.soThat: I ensure all trades comply with local laws before execution

acceptanceCriteria.given: A trade is submitted for validation
A trade is submitted for validation

acceptanceCriteria.then: System blocks execution and provides detailed rejection reason

userStories.title: Trade Confirmation and Notification
userStories.iWantTo: receive real-time notifications of trade confirmations
userStories.soThat: I can monitor trade flow and respond to issues immediately

acceptanceCriteria.then: All trade confirmations are displayed in chronological order

userStories.title: Audit Trail Management
userStories.iWantTo: access complete audit trails for all voice trades
userStories.soThat: I can review trade history and ensure regulatory compliance

acceptanceCriteria.then: System provides complete trade lifecycle including voice recording reference
System returns all trades within range with full details
System generates compliant audit report in PDF/Excel format

userStories.title: Voice Recording Integration
userStories.iWantTo: link electronic trade records with original voice recordings
userStories.soThat: I can verify trade details against source conversations when needed

acceptanceCriteria.then: System stores reference to voice recording with timestamp
System retrieves and plays corresponding voice segment

userStories.title: Trade Amendment and Cancellation
userStories.iWantTo: amend or cancel voice trades before settlement
userStories.soThat: I can correct errors or respond to client requests

acceptanceCriteria.then: System allows modification with approval workflow
System creates audit entry with reason and approver
System reverses trade and notifies all parties

functionalRequirements.description: System shall capture and convert voice trade data to electronic format
mainFlow: Apply voice recognition with financial terminology

functionalRequirements.description: System shall validate trades against jurisdiction-specific regulations
System shall maintain comprehensive audit trail for all trades
System shall integrate voice recordings with trade records
System shall provide real-time notifications for trade events
System shall support trade amendments and cancellations with approval workflow

errorAndEdgeCases: Voice recognition failure due to poor audio quality or heavy accent
Network timeout during trade submission causing duplicate entries
Conflicting regulations between Singapore and Indonesia for cross-border trades
System unavailability during market hours requiring fallback procedures
Partial trade execution requiring special handling
Voice recording storage failure requiring alternative audit mechanism
Multiple simultaneous amendment requests for same trade
Regulatory rule changes requiring system update during trading hours
Authentication token expiration during long voice calls
Database connection pool exhaustion during high volume periods
assumptions: Voice recognition technology can achieve 95%+ accuracy for financial terminology
All traders will have unique identifiers for authentication
Voice recordings can be stored for minimum regulatory retention period (7 years)
Network bandwidth sufficient for real-time voice streaming and processing
Existing trade settlement systems have APIs for integration
Compliance rules for SG and Indonesia are well-documented and stable
Users have modern browsers supporting WebRTC for voice capture
Trade volume will not exceed 10,000 transactions per day initially
openQuestions: What specific MAS regulations apply to voice trades under $1M in Singapore?
What are the exact OJK requirements for Indonesia voice trade electronification?
Should the system support other Southeast Asian jurisdictions in future?
What is the required voice recording retention period for each jurisdiction?
Are there preferred voice recognition providers or must it be built in-house?
What are the acceptable system response times for trade validation?
Should the system integrate with existing order management systems (OMS)?
What authentication methods are required (biometric, 2FA, etc.)?
Are there specific audit report formats required by regulators?
What is the disaster recovery and business continuity requirement?

tasks: Create trade data model and database schema
Write unit tests for voice capture
Perform integration testing with voice provider

definitionOfDone: Code reviewed and approved by senior developer
Security scan completed with no critical issues
Compliance validation completed for SG and Indonesia
UAT sign-off received from business stakeholders
sprintPlanning: Sprint 1-2: Core voice capture and trade data model (US-1)
Sprint 13: UAT and production deployment preparation
